summary: Tested Robinity task-points + public Leaderboard feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (new file test_x_points_leaderboard.py) covering /api/x/config points map {follow:20,like_rt:10,quote:50}, public /api/x/leaderboard (no cookie) returns 4+ seeded entries sorted desc, rank 1=alice_eth (80), bob_defi=70, carol_x=20, dave_nft=10, entries include rank/username/profile_image_url/points/completed, points map echoed, /api/x/me includes points field (0 initial), EVM save+409 conflict, POST /tasks/follow/verify returns points_awarded=20 and user.points=20, like_rt returns 503 (tweet not configured — expected), leaderboard subsequently includes robinity_tester with 20 pts. Frontend Playwright: header shows leaderboard-button when not connected on desktop and mobile; leaderboard-modal opens with leaderboard-list, rank1 alice_eth 80 pts confirmed via leaderboard-row-1/leaderboard-points-1; closes on Escape and via leaderboard-modal-close. Dev login redirects and shows tasks-button + profile; tasks-modal opens; evm-form accepts 0x123...5678 and saves; tasks-points-card + tasks-user-points visible (starts 0); task-{follow|like_rt|quote}-points badges show +20/+10/+50 pts. Follow open button opens https://x.com/intent/follow?screen_name=RobinityInt, verify awards 20 pts, toast displayed, tasks-user-points becomes 20, task-follow-done shows '✓ Done · +20', header tasks-button-points shows '20 pts'. Leaderboard row for robinity_tester carries class 'is-me' and 'you' label. Mobile 390px leaderboard modal has 0px horizontal overflow.

issues: CSS rule '.ri-header-x:not(:has(.ri-x-profile)) .ri-lb-button{display:inline-flex}' hides the Leaderboard button in the header for logged-in users on mobile. Not a blocker (task requirement targets no-overflow in modal, and modal opens fine on mobile without login), but a logged-in mobile user has no obvious entry point to open the Leaderboard. Consider surfacing a Leaderboard link inside the Tasks modal or keeping the header button visible on mobile.

critical_code_review_comments: x_router.py: user_points() sums TASK_POINTS live from tasks map; server also writes 'points' field on verify. leaderboard sort uses user_points(u) (fresh) but tie-breaker is by 'points_updated_at' asc via '\uffff' default — users without timestamp end up last within their tier which is fine. Consider persisting 'points' consistently (e.g., on evm-save) so the sort has a stable stored value for indexing at scale.

leaderboard filter uses {'evm_address': {'$exists': True}} — a user who verified follow but has not saved EVM won't appear on leaderboard even though they have points. Seeded users all have evm_address set so it's fine, but this can surprise real users. Consider also including users with points>0 OR make EVM save happen prior to any task.
Mobile header hides '.ri-lb-button' for logged-in users (styles.css line 22); no alternate entry point provided (see design_issues).
check_follow still iterates up to 5*1000 following pages per verify call — will be rate-limited once real X credentials are used; consider a bulk 'friends/ids' or caching strategy.
